title: Law to require mental health protocols for pregnant inmates
summary: This bill would require the Department of Correction, working with Correctional Health Services, to create and maintain written protocols for identifying, screening, referring, monitoring and following up on the mental health needs of pregnant and postpartum people in custody. The protocols must cover intake screening, expedited psychiatric evaluation, hospital referrals, documentation and discharge planning, and must be reviewed at least every two years and posted online. The law would take effect 180 days after enactment.
